desc:
Welcome to Drive Together! 

⚠️ This game is a CO-OP experience! You need friends or other players in the lobby to drive the car! ⚠️

Work together with 2 to 5 players to control a single car, avoid traps, and beat the obby!

🤝 TEAMWORK - Share the steering, gas, and brakes!
😈 TROLL ITEMS - Sabotage your friends or help them survive!
🏆 SPEEDRUN - Beat the tracks fast to climb the leaderboards!
✨ CHECKPOINTS - Your progress is saved in each world!

👍 Like the game +  Join group to unlock special rewards!

Script: @terola0
Model/Map: @yusufmsp @Junhantur
